# Voxel Browser

> A voxel game engine with a dedicated server, a client, and Lua-scripted content packs. Server logic, content and UI are written in sandboxed Lua 5.4; `vb` is the developer CLI.

## Make a content pack
- [Quick reference](lua-reference/README.md): every Lua function in one line, with a link to its signature and example
- [Lua API guide](lua-api.md): the narrative design reference (registration, events, UI VM, sandbox)
- [CLI reference](cli.md): every `vb` command, flags, exit codes, `--json` (`vb help --json` for tools)
- [Events](lua-reference/events.md): every `vb.on` event and its handler signature
- [Types](lua-reference/types.md): definition tables such as `BlockDef`, `EntityDef`, `PipelineDef`

## Guides
- [Structure editor](structure-editor.md): decorative structures for worldgen
- [Authentication](auth.md): pack-level `auth.lua` identity providers
- [Testing content/base](content-base-testing.md): layered tests for packs
- [Base pack UI](content-base-ui.md): HUD and screens of the bundled pack

## Protocol and automation
- [Wire protocol](protocol.md): normative message formats
- [Automation protocol](automation-protocol.md): JSON-lines driver for tests
- [End-to-end automation](e2e-automation.md): the multiplayer test harness
- [Server capacity benchmark](loadtest.md): `vb_loadtest` bots over real UDP, results

## Optional
- [Replication](replication.md): interest management design
